diagrams.title: **One server, one client, every primitive
diagrams.caption: **One server, one client, every primitive.** The client starts the server itself and they talk through pipes: no ports, no HTTP.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 400" aria-label="The MCP basics lab. server.py, built with FastMCP and named WeatherServer, exposes tools get_weather and list_client_roots, resources greeting://{name} and courses://directory, and prompts weather_report and generate_study_plan, and runs on stdio. client.py starts the server as a subprocess, discovers its capabilities, then calls the tools, reads the resources, fetches the prompts, and answers the server's roots request. Results: the weather in London, a greeting, the course list, two filled prompts, and the shared root." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
      <rect x="20" y="20" width="440" height="300" rx="18" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
      <text x="44" y="56" class="tl" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:24px;font-weight:700">server.py</text><text x="190" y="56" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">FastMCP("WeatherServer")</text>
      <text x="44" y="96" class="lab ink-tool" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#075A51;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">Tools</text><text x="150" y="96" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">get_weather(city)</text><text x="150" y="120" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">list_client_roots()</text>
      <text x="44" y="160" class="lab ink-data" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#1C3F8F;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">Resources</text><text x="150" y="160" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">greeting://{name}</text><text x="150" y="184" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">courses://directory (JSON)</text>
      <text x="44" y="224" class="lab ink-brain" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#6E4A00;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">Prompts</text><text x="150" y="224" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">weather_report(city)</text><text x="150" y="248" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">generate_study_plan(...)</text>
      <rect x="44" y="268" width="200" height="34" rx="17" class="bx" style="fill:#FFFFFF;stroke:#D7DCE8;stroke-width:2"></rect><text x="144" y="291" text-anchor="middle" class="lab" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">runs on stdio</text>
      <path d="M464 150 H636" class="ln" stroke-width="3" marker-start="url(#ah)" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path><text x="550" y="138" text-anchor="middle" class="lab" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">JSON-RPC</text><text x="550" y="174" text-anchor="middle" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:14px">stdin / stdout pipes</text>
      <rect x="640" y="20" width="440" height="300" rx="18" class="data" style="fill:#E1E9FC;stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
      <text x="664" y="56" class="tl" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:24px;font-weight:700">client.py</text><text x="810" y="56" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">ClientSession</text>
      <text x="664" y="96" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">1. Start the server as a subprocess</text>
      <text x="664" y="128" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">2. Handshake: initialize()</text>
      <text x="664" y="160" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">3. Discover tools, resources, prompts</text>
      <text x="664" y="192" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">4. Call tools, read resources</text>
      <text x="664" y="224" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">5. Get prompts</text>
      <text x="664" y="256" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">6. Answer the server's roots request</text>
      <rect x="20" y="340" width="1060" height="44" rx="12" class="bx2" style="fill:#F8F9FC;stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2"></rect>
      <text x="40" y="368" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">Results: "Weather in London: 15°C, cloudy" · "Hello, Developer!…" · 3 courses · 2 filled prompts · "Course workspace: file:///…"</text>
    </svg>

diagrams.title: **Same pattern, any server
diagrams.caption: **Same pattern, any server.** Swap the command that starts the server and the agent gets a completely different toolbox, with no other code changes.

      <path d="M540 190 Q600 260 676 260" class="ln-data" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah-data)" style="stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path><text x="572" y="258" class="lab ink-data" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#1C3F8F;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">stdio</text>
      <rect x="680" y="20" width="400" height="110" rx="16" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="700" y="54" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Local: mcp-basics/server.py</text><text x="700" y="84" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">get_weather, list_client_roots</text><text x="700" y="112" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">started with sys.executable</text>
